Interactive Brokers wins on pricing transparency — published commission schedules, tiered and fixed structures you can model before depositing. sections.heading: Is Exante Worth Your Money in 2026?
sections.body:
Four regulators. Over one million instruments. Zero custody fees on stocks and ETFs. On paper, Exante looks like one of the most serious multi-asset platforms available to professional traders outside of Interactive Brokers. And for the most part, that reputation holds — FCA, CySEC, MFSA, and SFC Hong Kong provide genuine multi-jurisdictional oversight with investor compensation schemes in two of those jurisdictions. The instrument range is not marketing inflation either — real access to 50+ exchanges covering equities, bonds, futures, options, and currencies from a single account.

But here is the reality that most affiliate reviews gloss over: you need EUR 10,000 just to open an individual account. EUR 50,000 for corporate. This is not a platform designed for someone learning to trade forex with a few hundred euros. It is built for wealth managers running client portfolios, professional traders who already know exactly which instruments they need, and HNW individuals who want consolidated multi-market access under serious regulation. If that description does not fit you, this review is academic.

Exante suits capital-rich professionals who need global market access with regulatory substance behind it. The high entry barrier is the filter — and it works as intended.

sections.heading: Is Exante Regulated? — Licence Check 2026
sections.body:
Yes — across four separate jurisdictions, which is stronger coverage than most brokers in this space can demonstrate. The primary entity XNT Ltd sits under MFSA (Malta Financial Services Authority) regulation. The UK arm LHCM Ltd is authorised by the FCA — giving access to FSCS protection up to GBP 85,000 for eligible UK clients. EXT Ltd in Cyprus holds a CySEC licence with ICF coverage up to EUR 20,000. And XHK Ltd operates in Hong Kong under SFC licence BNN565.

This multi-entity structure is not window dressing. Each licence carries real obligations — capital adequacy, fund segregation, regular reporting, and access to compensation schemes where applicable. The FCA entity is particularly notable because FSCS protection means your first GBP 85,000 has a government-backed safety net if the firm fails. That is meaningful protection.

One regulatory concern worth flagging: MAS Singapore issued a warning against Exante for unauthorised provision of financial services in Singapore. Under NAFT methodology, MAS is not in the Tier-1 kill-switch list, so this does not cap the score — but it means Exante was operating in Singapore without proper authorisation at some point. Four clean licences elsewhere offset this, but it deserves acknowledgement rather than burial. NAFT last reviewed Exante regulation in May 2026.

sections.heading: Exante Fees and Pricing — What Do You Actually Pay?
sections.body:
Exante operates a commission-based pricing model rather than the spread-markup structure common at retail forex brokers. For US equities, commissions start from $0.02 per share — competitive with Interactive Brokers at similar volumes. Stocks and ETFs carry zero custody fees, which is a genuine advantage for buy-and-hold portfolio traders who would otherwise pay quarterly or annual holding charges elsewhere.

The challenge with Exante's fee structure is transparency relative to competitors. Interactive Brokers publishes exhaustive commission tables by asset class and volume tier. Exante's public pricing information requires more digging and negotiation, particularly for futures, options, and fixed income. You know the minimum per-share rate, but the complete picture across 50+ markets and multiple asset classes is not laid out as clearly as IBKR's tiered schedules.

Forex spreads are variable and the platform does not position itself as a tight-spread forex specialist. If your primary interest is leveraged currency trading with pip-level spread competition, Exante is not built for that fight. This is a platform where forex sits alongside a million other instruments as one option among many. Overnight financing charges, shorting commissions, and flat withdrawal fees all apply — the fee model rewards large, active portfolios rather than small frequent trades. The EUR 10,000 minimum deposit already signals this: Exante expects clients who trade at a scale where per-share commissions matter more than pip spreads.

sections.heading: Exante Deposits and Withdrawals — Speed and Methods
sections.body:
Bank wire is the primary funding method — SWIFT for international and SEPA for European clients. Card payments via Visa and Mastercard are accepted. The minimum deposit of EUR 10,000 for individuals means this is not a platform where you test with pocket change. Corporate accounts require EUR 50,000. These are serious capital requirements that filter the client base by design.

Withdrawals follow a clear cutoff system: requests submitted before 11AM EET process same-day. Anything after that cutoff moves to the next business day. This is transparent and predictable — you know exactly when your money will move based on when you submit the request. Wire transfer is the primary withdrawal method with flat fees applied.

The practical reality for most clients is that Exante processes withdrawals in a timely manner consistent with its institutional positioning. You are not going to get instant Skrill payouts here — this is banking-speed infrastructure designed for clients moving meaningful capital. Flat withdrawal charges mean the percentage impact decreases as your withdrawal size increases, which aligns with the high-minimum client profile.

sections.heading: Exante Withdrawals in 2026 — The Real Picture
sections.body:
The 11AM EET cutoff is the key detail. Submit your withdrawal request before that time on a business day and it processes same-day. Miss the window and you wait until the next business day. This is clearer than most brokers manage — no vague promises of processing within arbitrary timeframes that actually mean whenever the finance team gets around to it.

Public withdrawal complaints about Exante are limited, but this reflects the small client base more than necessarily perfect execution. With a EUR 10,000 minimum, the number of retail traders with direct experience is a fraction of what you would see with a broker offering $100 entry. The complaints that do surface — primarily on European review platforms — mention occasional delays and fee-related frustrations rather than systematic withholding of funds.

Wire transfer dominates. No e-wallet instant payouts. No cryptocurrency withdrawal options publicly documented. If you need your money back fast, submit before 11AM EET and expect same-day wire dispatch. For international SWIFT transfers, add 1-2 business days for intermediary bank processing on your end. The flat fee structure means a $50,000 withdrawal costs the same flat charge as a $10,000 one — which rewards larger withdrawals proportionally.

If your withdrawal stalls beyond the stated timeframe: contact Exante support directly with your transfer reference. For CySEC entity clients, the Cyprus Securities and Exchange Commission offers a formal complaints process. FCA entity clients can escalate through the Financial Ombudsman Service if the firm is unresponsive.

sections.heading: Exante Red Flags — What to Know Before You Deposit
sections.body: The MAS Singapore warning is the headline concern. The Monetary Authority of Singapore flagged Exante for providing financial services without authorisation in Singapore. This is not a scam accusation — it is a jurisdictional compliance failure where Exante operated in a market it was not licensed to serve. Under NAFT methodology, MAS is not on the Tier-1 kill-switch list (FCA, ASIC, BaFin, CySEC, IOSCO), so the score is not capped. But it raises questions about the firm's compliance culture in grey-zone jurisdictions. The EUR 10,000 minimum creates an unusual review landscape — very few retail traders share experiences publicly because most never qualify to open an account. This makes independent verification of withdrawal speed and client service harder than with mass-market brokers. Some complaints about fee transparency and withdrawal processing delays have surfaced on European review platforms, though the volume is low. The proprietary-only platform means no MT4 or MT5 compatibility. If Exante ever closes or you decide to move, your trade history and custom configurations do not port to a standard platform. Platform lock-in is real. NAFT last reviewed Exante in May 2026.

sections.heading: Who Should Use Exante — and Who Should Not
sections.body:
Exante draws a hard line with that EUR 10,000 minimum. This is not a broker that wants retail forex traders depositing their first $500 and learning about pips. It is purpose-built for wealth managers who need consolidated access to bonds, equities, and derivatives across 50+ exchanges. For asset managers running client portfolios, the zero custody fees on stocks and ETFs represent genuine cost savings at scale. And the multi-regulator structure gives compliance teams something real to point at during due diligence.

But if forex is your primary instrument, or you trade fewer than a dozen instruments regularly, Exante is the wrong tool for the job. The platform complexity and high minimum serve professionals who actually use the breadth. A trader who deposits EUR 10,000 to trade three currency pairs is paying for infrastructure they will never touch.

sections.heading: How to Open an Exante Account — Step by Step
sections.body: Account opening is digital but expect thorough due diligence given the institutional positioning. The EUR 10,000 minimum means Exante applies stricter onboarding checks than retail brokers — source of funds documentation is standard rather than exceptional.

steps.title: Register
steps.detail: Visit exante.eu and select Open Account. Choose individual or corporate application. Complete the application form including personal details, financial background, investment experience, and source of funds declaration. Select your preferred entity based on residency — UK, Cyprus, Malta, or Hong Kong. The application takes approximately 15 minutes.

steps.title: Verify your identity (KYC)
steps.detail: Upload passport or national ID plus proof of address dated within 3 months. Source of funds documentation is typically required given the EUR 10,000 minimum — bank statements or employment verification demonstrating the origin of your deposit. Expect 1-3 business days for verification depending on document quality and entity. Corporate accounts require additional company documentation.

steps.title: Fund your account and test a withdrawal
steps.detail: Deposit the minimum EUR 10,000 via bank wire or card. Once funded, access the platform and familiarise yourself with the multi-asset interface. Place a small trade to verify execution. Then request a withdrawal before 11AM EET and confirm same-day processing works as stated before committing larger capital. The demo account with EUR 1,000,000 virtual currency is available if you want to test the platform before depositing real funds.

sections.practical_note: Use the demo account first — EUR 1,000,000 in virtual currency lets you test the proprietary platform without committing EUR 10,000 upfront. Once satisfied with the interface and execution, fund with the minimum and immediately test a withdrawal to confirm the 11AM EET same-day processing. Scale up only after that test clears.

sections.heading: Exante Final Verdict — Is It Worth It in 2026?
sections.body:
NAFT scores Exante 7.4 out of 10. Four regulated entities across FCA, CySEC, MFSA, and SFC Hong Kong provide genuine multi-jurisdictional safety — a regulatory structure that most brokers in this space cannot match. FSCS protection up to GBP 85,000 on the UK entity and ICF coverage up to EUR 20,000 on Cyprus give eligible clients real compensation safety nets. The instrument range exceeding one million products is not marketing noise — it represents actual access to equities, bonds, futures, options, and currencies across 50+ global exchanges.

The score does not reach 8 or 9 because of three factors working against it. The EUR 10,000 minimum deposit excludes the vast majority of traders who might read this review. Fee transparency lags behind Interactive Brokers — the dominant competitor in this space. And the MAS Singapore warning, while not fatal, represents a compliance lapse that a firm of this regulatory breadth should not have on its record.

If you manage client portfolios, run an asset management firm, or simply have significant personal capital that needs multi-market access under serious regulation — Exante is a legitimate option worth evaluating against Interactive Brokers and Saxo Bank. NAFT recommends it specifically for professional traders depositing EUR 50,000+ who need the breadth of instruments and regulatory coverage that retail-focused brokers cannot provide. For anyone else — and that includes most people reading broker reviews online — the EUR 10,000 door is closed, and platforms like Interactive Brokers offer similar institutional access without that barrier.

faq.q: Is Exante legit or a scam?
faq.a: Exante is a legitimate multi-asset broker — not a scam. It holds four separate regulatory licences: FCA UK (LHCM Ltd), CySEC Cyprus (EXT Ltd), MFSA Malta (XNT Ltd), and SFC Hong Kong (XHK Ltd, licence BNN565). FSCS protection up to GBP 85,000 applies to UK entity clients and ICF up to EUR 20,000 for Cyprus entity clients. Exante has operated since 2011 serving professional traders and wealth managers across 100+ countries. One concern: MAS Singapore flagged Exante for unauthorised services, though four clean Tier-1/Tier-2 licences elsewhere provide strong overall safety.

faq.q: What is the Exante minimum deposit?
faq.a: Exante requires EUR 10,000 minimum deposit for individual accounts and EUR 50,000 for corporate accounts. This is significantly higher than most retail brokers and reflects Exante's positioning as a platform for professional traders, wealth managers, and HNW individuals rather than retail beginners. There is no lower-tier account available. A demo account with EUR 1,000,000 in virtual currency is available to test the platform before committing real capital.

faq.q: How long do Exante withdrawals take?
faq.a: Exante withdrawals process same-day if your request is submitted before the 11AM EET cutoff on a business day. Requests after that time process the next business day. Wire transfer is the primary withdrawal method with flat fees applied. International SWIFT transfers may take an additional 1-2 business days for intermediary bank processing on the receiving end. The system is predictable once you understand the cutoff timing.

faq.q: Is Exante regulated by the FCA?
faq.a: Yes — Exante operates in the UK through LHCM Ltd, which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA). This entity provides access to FSCS protection up to GBP 85,000 for eligible clients. The FCA entity is available to UK professional investors and intermediaries rather than general retail clients. Exante also holds licences from CySEC Cyprus, MFSA Malta, and SFC Hong Kong — four regulated entities in total.

faq.q: Does Exante offer MetaTrader 4 or MT5?
faq.a: No — Exante does not offer MetaTrader 4 or MetaTrader 5. The platform is entirely proprietary, available as a web application, desktop client, and mobile app. The EXANTE platform is designed for multi-asset portfolio management across stocks, bonds, futures, options, and forex rather than leveraged CFD trading. If MetaTrader compatibility is important to you, Exante is not the right choice. There is no third-party platform integration available.

Exante offers access to over 1,000,000 instruments across 50+ global markets. This includes stocks and ETFs with zero custody fees, over 20,000 bonds, more than 3,000 futures contracts, options, forex currencies, and metals. The range spans exchanges in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and the Middle East. This is one of the broadest instrument offerings available from any broker — comparable to Interactive Brokers in scope.

faq.q: Is Exante safe for large deposits?
faq.a: Exante provides multi-jurisdictional regulatory protection suitable for large deposits. UK entity clients receive FSCS coverage up to GBP 85,000. Cyprus entity clients get ICF protection up to EUR 20,000. All entities maintain segregated client funds. The four-regulator structure means multiple independent oversight bodies monitor the firm. For deposits significantly exceeding compensation scheme limits, the same residual risk applies as with any broker — regulation reduces but does not eliminate counterparty risk.

faq.q: How does Exante compare to Interactive Brokers?
faq.a: Both are multi-asset platforms targeting professional traders with massive instrument ranges. Interactive Brokers wins on pricing transparency with published commission schedules, lower minimum deposit (no formal minimum versus Exante's EUR 10,000), and broader platform choice including TWS, IBKR Mobile, and third-party integrations. Exante wins on European regulatory breadth with four separate entities versus IBKR's centralised routing. For most traders, Interactive Brokers offers better value and accessibility. Exante suits those specifically wanting multi-regulator European segregation.
